name: Guisarme
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 19, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 143
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 19, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 143
Statistics
Cost 9 gp Weight 12 lbs.
Damage 1d6 (small), 2d4 (medium); Critical x3; Range —; Type S; Special reach, trip
Category Two-Handed; Proficiency Martial
Weapon Groups Polearms
Description
A guisarme is an 8-foot-long shaft with a blade and a hook mounted at the tip.
